rows.remaining: The listed concrete PSD and finite-sum lemmas are closed; actual PGM support-spectrum and normalization proofs are now also available.

rows.title: Periodicity and injectivity of complex phase encoding, and completeness for physical eigenvalues
rows.paper_coverage: Full equivalence between arbitrary original compatible complex-phase assignments and the finite ZMod(2p) encoding; the root-of-unity condition follows from compatibility.
rows.remaining: All primes and zero dimension; no claim of gauge transport for an arbitrary section.

rows.title: Unitarity of the concrete Pauli operators, multiplication/cocycle, and equivalence of commutation with symplectic orthogonality
rows.paper_coverage: Multiplication, unitarity, trace, and commutation for isotropic assignments in the actual XZ section are proved.
rows.remaining: The original XZ section is fixed; actual Clifford implementation of arbitrary symplectic transformations with full phase correction is now proved.

rows.title: Orthogonality, self-adjointness, PSD, rank formulas, and completeness of the joint-projector family
rows.paper_coverage: The complete projector family over all original assignments: existence, exact count, orthogonality, resolution of the identity, joint eigenspaces, and exact ranks.
rows.remaining: Assignment existence and resolution of the identity are closed within the proof, without an externally supplied reference assignment.

rows.title: Every valid label projector is a pure density matrix, with a correspondence to all projective stabilizer states
rows.paper_coverage: A bijection between all valid Lagrangian labels and the original distinct pure stabilizer density matrices.
rows.remaining: A closed formula for the total number of all Lagrangians or all states is not yet proved; the correspondence stated by this node is closed.

rows.title: Nonemptiness of stabilizer inputs, valid reports, and the set of all learner POVMs
rows.paper_coverage: Nonemptiness of the original stabilizer input set, reports for every valid W, and the set of all learner POVMs is established by construction.
rows.remaining: Actual nonemptiness is proved; nonempty report or measurement sets are not added as new hypotheses.

rows.title: Equivalence of the physical eigenvalue equations with the paper's K≤Lₓ and η=χₓ|K criterion
rows.paper_coverage: The original physical Valid predicate is exactly equivalent to containment of K in the input Lagrangian and restriction of the assignment; multiple correct reports for exceptional inputs are retained.
rows.remaining: The complete original report event is closed; it is not replaced by a canonical label, and target uniqueness is not assumed.

rows.title: Positivity and normalization of tensor densities, Born probabilities, and membership of the four optima in [0,1]
rows.paper_coverage: Positivity and normalization of the original tensorPower density, actual Born weights, [0,1] bounds for pointwise scores, both aggregations, and all four optima, and the sharp affine comparison are closed.
rows.remaining: The sup_M inf_x order and the original uniform prior on distinct states are preserved; actual fixed-W report/learner nonemptiness is also proved in this round.

rows.title: The actual Lüders average equals the report's Born score, and correct reports score one
rows.paper_coverage: The original normalization on positive-probability branches, zero-probability branches, averaging over all assignments, score exactly one for correct reports, and score ≤1/p for incorrect reports are proved without assuming the key bounds.
rows.remaining: The averaged identity does not assert equality of conditional scores for each ν. A fixed 1/p remainder cannot imply convergence to zero; the original verification converse is now closed using actual phase-compatible lists and a tail that vanishes with D.

rows.title: Bridges from the uniform XZ section to odd-prime Weyl/binary Z₄ coordinates and the proved moment chain
rows.paper_coverage: Actual P_id for standard and arbitrary public frames, the original fixed-W finite exact comparison, and uniform J are closed, preserving the complete target and all POVMs.
rows.remaining: The literal phase-adjusted Weyl/W_A/W_C operators, named verifier operators, and interfaces specific to refined verification remain partially open; the original physical bridges, complete converse, direct result, and Main have been accepted.

rows.title: Dimension-only covariance, achievable-rate sets, and liminf/sInf properties
rows.paper_coverage: Covariance over all W, all POVMs, an actual rate-one witness, both original liminf/sInf exact rates, and the original Main are closed.

progress_policy: Use mathematical statement coverage and dependency closure, never lines or generated file counts.
